    s.state_name       AS State,
    d.district_name    AS District,
    b.block_name       AS Block,
    g.gp_name          AS GP,
    cr.village_id      AS Village,
    cr.creche_name     AS Creche,
    cr.name            AS Creche_ID,
    cr.creche_opening_date AS Creche_Opening_Date,

    -- Month-wise pivots (example Jan–Oct)
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 1  THEN (cal.attendance = 1) END) 
          / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 1  THEN ca.date_of_attendance END),0),1) AS Jan,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 2  THEN (cal.attendance = 1) END) 
          / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 2  THEN ca.date_of_attendance END),0),1) AS Feb,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 3  THEN (cal.attendance = 1) END) 
          / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 3  THEN ca.date_of_attendance END),0),1) AS Mar,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 4  THEN (cal.attendance = 1) END) 
          / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 4  THEN ca.date_of_attendance END),0),1) AS April,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 5  THEN (cal.attendance = 1) END) 
          / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 5  THEN ca.date_of_attendance END),0),1) AS May,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 6  THEN (cal.attendance = 1) END) 
          / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 6  THEN ca.date_of_attendance END),0),1) AS June,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 7  THEN (cal.attendance = 1) END) 
          / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 7  THEN ca.date_of_attendance END),0),1) AS July,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 8  THEN (cal.attendance = 1) END) 
          / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 8  THEN ca.date_of_attendance END),0),1) AS August,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 9  THEN (cal.attendance = 1) END) 
          / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 9  THEN ca.date_of_attendance END),0),1) AS Sep,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 10 THEN (cal.attendance = 1) END) 
          / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN MONTH(ca.date_of_attendance) = 10 THEN ca.date_of_attendance END),0),1) AS Oct

FROM `tabChild Attendance` ca
JOIN `tabChild Attendance List` cal ON cal.parent = ca.name
INNER JOIN `tabCreche` cr ON cr.name = ca.creche_id
INNER JOIN `tabGram Panchayat` g ON g.name = cr.gp_id
INNER JOIN `tabBlock` b ON b.name = cr.block_id
INNER JOIN `tabDistrict` d ON d.name = cr.district_id
INNER JOIN `tabState` s ON s.name = cr.state_id
INNER JOIN `tabPartner` p ON p.name = cr.partner_id

WHERE ca.is_shishu_ghar_is_closed_for_the_day = 0
  AND YEAR(ca.date_of_attendance) = 2025

GROUP BY 
    p.partner_name, s.state_name, d.district_name, b.block_name, 
    g.gp_name, cr.village_id, cr.creche_name, cr.name, cr.creche_opening_date
